name: quotient-selector-default-edges
cmd: set -euo pipefail; input=$PWD/port-input; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; for name in source gdp-ts handwired; do tar -xf "$input/$name.tar" -C "$temp"; done; (cd "$temp" && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null); bun research/lane-i/request-quotient/edge-cases.ts "$temp"
